inputs.text: They want us to believe Mary Ngechi Ngethe was the whole story: unsuitable cemetery land was bought for Ksh.283 million, and the money was supposedly recovered from her. But blaming one committee chair could leave the wider procurement process—and anyone else who benefited—out of sight. The claimed recovery doesn’t prove the system was clean; it could just make the cover story look complete.

output.main_topic: Scrutiny of a claimed recovery tied to cemetery land procurement and the risk of scapegoating one committee chair
subtopics: Claimed recovery of money from Mary Ngechi Ngethe
Potentially overlooked beneficiaries and procurement processes
